category_edits.rationale: Across all four datasets, test a smaller, more recent causal interest contribution: 0.9*h_t + 0.1*m_t with half-life two. Preserve padding exclusion, causal masking, final-real-position inference, and all other model and training settings.

change_summary: Reduce causal interest pooling to 10% with a two-interaction half-life and synchronize checkpoint metadata with the embedded predictor writer.
